title: sonde runs -f json
description: The runs recorded, newest first: the data directory's, and those written elsewhere with `-o`.

name.description: The file's name; its path when it was written elsewhere.

program.description: The program it is a run of: its `[program] name`, else its command with what changes between runs said as what it is (`--date {date}`) and a trial's place left out; null for a replay, an import or a recording without a command.

command.description: The command it ran, as it ran it; absent when none.

clients.description: The clients that sent its requests, by their user agents, with no version (`boto3`, `object_store`, `Lance`, `Iceberg (pyiceberg)`, `aws-cli`): the one that sent most, and a second when each sent a tenth or more; absent when none said.

exit.description: How its program exited (128 + a signal; 143 when sonde was sent SIGTERM); absent when not known (a proxy's, a replay's, an import's).

unreadable.description: Display text, not stable: why the file does not read as a run (its first line in the middle that is no record, `line 2: …`); `show` refuses it (exit 65). Absent for a run that reads.

elsewhere.description: Written outside the data directory's runs folder (`-o`): listed by its path, never pruned; absent otherwise.
